__title: Pricing: the report book stays free · MyWorkLog
__metaDescription: The MyWorkLog report book stays free: AI assistant, PDF in the IHK template, trainer sign-off. What comes next is what apprentices asked for in our survey. It is already here, just still sealed.
__ogDescription: The report book stays free. What comes next is already here, just still closed.
prLede.das_berichtsheft_bleibt_kostenlos: The report book stays free, with AI assistant, PDF in the IHK template and trainer sign-off. What comes next is what you asked for in the survey. It is already here, just still closed.
prHefteU.eins_ist_offen_die_anderen: One is open. You can put your name down for the others: it counts as a vote for which one opens first.
hefte.berichtsheft_ohne_grenze_tag_fuer: Report book without limits, day by day or week by week
hefte.assistent_mit_kestrel_31_turbo: Assistant with Kestrel 3.1 Turbo and Albatros 2.5 Marathon
hefte.lernt_mit_jeder_woche_wie: Learns how you write, week by week
hefte.kein_tageslimit_bei_kestrel_turbo: No daily limit on Kestrel Turbo
hefte.pruefungscheck_vor_der_abgabe: Exam check before you hand it in
hefte.deutlich_staerkere_ki_fuer_jede: Much stronger AI for every week
prVormerkHinweis.vormerken_zaehlt_nur_mi: Counting you in only records which book is wanted. No name, no account, no email.
prWunschU.umfrage_unter_nutzern_oktober_: User survey, October 2026, 10 votes. Next to each wish: where it goes.
prF1.bleibt_das_kostenlose_berichtsheft_: Will the free report book stay free?
prF1.ja_das_berichtsheft_bleibt_fuer: Yes, the report book stays free forever: writing, saving, PDF in the IHK template, trainer sign-off. We cannot promise that for the AI. Every answer costs us money, and how much of it stays free depends on what it costs us.
prF2.wenn_sie_fertig_sind_es: When they are ready. There is no date and no price yet. Whatever gets the most votes comes first.
prF3.was_passiert_beim_vormerken: What happens when I count myself in?
prF3.gezaehlt_wird_nur_wie_oft: Only the number of times a book was picked is counted. No name is stored, no account is created and no email address is asked for. Your device then shows “Noted” so you do not click twice.
